entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Sorry for the last-minute visit.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: How's Yoshizawa-san holding up?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I've been concerned about a potential[n]relapse, considering her difficulties[n]with accepting this reality.
She's just fine.
Sumire's one tough lady.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I see... No, that's great news.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...You know, I would love for that to be[n]the truth.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But, people can't maintain their strength[n]forever, [lName]-kun.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: So... Getting down to business...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I wanted to confirm with you one last[n]time: is there no other way to come[n]to an agreement besides fighting?
We can't accept this reality.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: The reality I created may seem distorted[n]from your point-of-view...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But it's a reality where everyone[n]is happy.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: If you just stay, you'll never have to suffer[n]the pain of loss, or the pain from having[n]people and things stolen away from you!
Like you have?
What was stolen from you?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: So... You saw what happened with[n]Rumi.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'm not the one who suffered—she is...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But she's still living a wonderful life[n]right now...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...In this world you call a "distorted[n]reality."

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But she still doesn't remember you,[n]right? And you're fine with that?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: She may not be in my life anymore, but[n]at least her own life is a happy one now.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'm not just doing this for Rumi—I want[n]all of you to live just as happily as she is...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But for Rumi's happiness to last, I have[n]to move on.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: After all that's happened to her—to me—[n]I just can't drag her into it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Doc...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: My stance will not change.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Strange circumstances have led to my[n]gaining this power—however, I now[n]recognize it as being wholly inevitable.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: This is something only I am capable of[n]doing. I promise: every person alive[n]will be happy in the world I create...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: So, let me ask you the same: after really[n]considering every option, do you have[n]any doubts about your views?
What do you mean?
What are you getting at?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I suppose it's more accurate to ask,[n]"Do you two gentlemen have any[n]doubts?"

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You're here, aren't you?[n]...Akechi-kun.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Akechi...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...You caught me.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Oh, it was just a hunch.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: This issue doesn't only affect you,[n][lName]-kun...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Akechi-kun, this involves you, too.
Akechi's involved?
Both Akechi and me?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What do these two have to do with...?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: The relationship you two share is[n]very unusual...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: A detective and a phantom thief. Despite[n]being enemies, your relationship isn't[n]based on hatred or ill will...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: That's why I found it so tragic when[n]I learned what happened in Shido's[n]Palace...

entries.speaker: Cognitive Akechi
entries.en: You bastard!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So, my final enemy is a puppet version[n]of myself...
entries.uk: Отже, мій останній ворог — маріонеткова[n]версія мене самого...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Say, [lName]-kun... Didn't you regret[n]how things ended with him?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You two came to a deep understanding[n]of one another... yet you had no choice[n]but to leave Akechi-kun to his fate.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: That's why I created a reality where[n]you two could have a fresh start[n]together.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Heh... After all this, that's what you have[n]to say? Seriously, you really are...
entries.uk: Хех... Після всього цього ти кажеш[n]таке? Серйозно, ти й справді...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That would mean the Akechi[n]in the real world is...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Get what I'm saying?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I genuinely didn't want to tell you[n]like this. I didn't want to make it seem[n]like I'm holding him hostage...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But no matter what you may think of me,[n]I just want you all to accept this reality[n]and move on with your happy lives.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...And that matters, how, exactly?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Don't tell me you think dangling my life[n]before us is going to have any impact[n]on our decision.
You figured that out?
So, you knew...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, I lacked conclusive evidence...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But after I fought against you all, I had[n]a gap in my memory that ended with[n]meeting up with [fName] again.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: There were also the cases of Wakaba[n]Isshiki and President Okumura...[n]Of course I'd find all of that suspicious.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I see.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I had a feeling the truth of the matter still[n]wouldn't dissuade you, Akechi-kun...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But how about you, [lName]-kun?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: "You think dangling my life before us is[n]going to affect our decision?" That's what[n]Akechi-kun said a moment ago.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: If that's how you see it at this point,[n]I'm fine with it...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But I'm still going to ask you, one last[n]time: Will you accept the reality I create[n]for you?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You were the guiding light to my[n]research. You showed me the way so[n]I could make my dream into reality.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I have nothing but gratitude for you—[n]not a single ounce of ill will. That's why[n]I wanted you of all people to understand...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Perhaps I shouldn't ask you for an answer[n]on the spot like that.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'll be going now.
This is for you.
You forgot something.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Ah, that's right.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I've heard your calling.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: And, about my question—let's do this...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'll be waiting in the Palace tomorrow,[n]just as I promised.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: If you still haven't changed your mind[n]by then, we'll meet there...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But if you don't show, I'll take that to[n]mean you've accepted my reality.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...See you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...What are you gonna do?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'd like to speak with [fName].

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Akechi...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Gotcha.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'll leave the decision up to you,[n][fName]—let me know when[n]you've reached an answer.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...I will carve my own path for myself.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I refuse to accept a reality concocted by[n]someone else, stuck under their control[n]for the rest of my days.
Are you sure?
But then, you'll...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Why wouldn't I be?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Don't ask such stupid questions[n]after all this time.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So what?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That's the path I chose.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: All you have to do is stick to your guns[n]and challenge Maruki.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Or, are you really so spineless that you'd[n]fold over some bullshit, trivial threat[n]on my life?
This isn't "trivial"!
Don't oversimplify this.
I won't fold.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It IS!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Do you think I'd be happy with this?[n]Being shown mercy now, of all times?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I don't want to be pitied—this isn't[n]something I'm debating with you!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Your indecisiveness on the matter is[n]essentially a betrayal of my wishes.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh, but it IS simple.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Do you think I'd be happy with this?[n]Being shown mercy now, of all times?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I don't want to be pitied—this isn't[n]something I'm debating with you!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Your indecisiveness on the matter is[n]essentially a betrayal of my wishes.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Then you already know what needs[n]to be done...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...I want to hear you say it aloud.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: What do you intend to do?
If we fight against Maruki[n]and win, we'll return to[n]the original reality...
But... Akechi...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I won't wait a moment longer.[n]Answer me.
We're stopping Maruki.
We're taking the offer.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: All right. I'm relieved to hear it.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I will never accept this form of reality.[n]I'm done being manipulated.
entries.uk: Я ніколи не прийму такої реальності.[n]Досить мною маніпулювати.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Let's go back... to our true reality.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: This is great... I feel so alive! I'll sow[n]chaos as far as the eye can see!
entries.uk: Чудово... Я почуваюся таким живим![n]Сіятиму хаос, скільки сягає око!

entries.en: Akechi's Persona [clr 1]Loki[clr 27] has[n]transformed into [clr 2]Hereward[clr 27]!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: What's a life worth in a reality that was[n]cooked up just to satisfy someone else?[n]I say none.
entries.uk: Чого варте життя в реальності, вигаданій[n]лише для того, щоб догодити комусь[n]іншому? Як на мене — нічого.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We have to win this—no matter what.
There's no going back now...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...Are you serious?
I misspoke.
I am serious.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Then I'll ask again...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: What do you intend to do?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...Well, I have your answer.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: There's nothing left I can say.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Our deal's off.
...Did I really make[n]the right decision?
